scope: New source-bound conditional primary-only CaseA H/He/thermal15.9to4 run using N1 native RHS and N2 fixed covectors; not physical EoR or CR/RCT admission

IC.radiation: HM12 UVB at initial epoch inside supported10..50000eV; zero outside; no imposition at laterepochs
IC.authority: prospective conditional IC; NOT HyRec history

source: HM12 author emissivity.out stage energy/redshift, current10..50000eV band; q support spans source entry at late times

conventions.thermal: imported Grackle CaseA RR/CI/DR/CE/ff plus signed isotropic-CMB bath exchange

field_comparison: max absolute difference / max whole-history amplitude of each field; report per-field; shared epochs
energy_budget_secondary_metric: also report residual divided by max initial+absolute accumulated source/work/escape/CMB terms; diagnostic only, not replacement for fixed initial-energy target
spectral_angular: empirical refinement separately; no continuum certificate inferred from time convergence
numerical_candidate: BDF with native gas4 finite-difference columns and analytic sparse photon/ledger columns; no invalid-state clipping; retain stage-domain failure
stages: first diagnostic broad run; unchanged-contract refinement after first evidence; independent decision before promotion
excluded: No RUN002 rerun, no CaseB replacement, no highTguard removal, no observational fitting, no totalCMBtau claim
